title: Cures and Concoctions
description: Create cures for various status effects in Minecraft!
body:
![Picture](https://i.ibb.co/3kMBdPT/Cures-NConcoctions-1.png)


Create cures for various status effects in minecraft!

Recipes:

Glass Vial - Crafted with two blocks of glass

Antidote - Crafted with a glass vial and poisonous potato - Cures poison and nausea

Berry Juice - Crafted with a glass vial and sweet berries - Cures slowness

Bottled Flame - Crafted with a glass vial and sweet berries - Cures weakness

Glow Juice - Crafted with a glass vial and sweet berries - Cures blindness and darkness

Membrane Extract - Crafted with a glass vial and sweet berries - Cures levitation

Tropical Purée - Crafted with a glass vial and sweet berries - Cures wither
